name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Air of Sickness
text:
30 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn in the aura must attempt a Fortitude save save with a moderate DC for the nosferatu's level. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 1 and takes a –2 status penalty to saves made to resist diseases and remove the sickened condition for 1 hour.

Effect: Air of Sickness
